_doc: Curated Phase-1 testbed for the DIVERSE-COVERAGE objective. Unlike the real dataset (single ground-truth utterance), each turn here is annotated with `plausible_utterances`: the SET of genuinely different things the AAC user might want to say at that moment, spanning distinct conversational directions (answer / question-back / redirect / affirm / decline / comment / request). The board's job is to COVER this space within ~7 slots, not to guess one. Coverage = fraction of plausible_utterances with a usable match on the board. Authored by the team for team-only testing (consent guardrail).

scenarios.setting: Student (AAC user) in a science class. Teacher is mid-lecture and starting to ask the class questions.
scenarios.scene: A classroom. A teacher stands at a whiteboard with a diagram of a leaf and the sun. Other students sit at desks.

turns.last_utterance: Teacher: So plants make their own food through a process called photosynthesis.
turns.transcript:
Teacher: Today we're learning about how plants get energy.
Teacher: So plants make their own food through a process called photosynthesis.

turns.last_utterance: Teacher: Can anyone tell me what plants take in from the air?
turns.transcript:
Teacher: So plants make their own food through a process called photosynthesis.
Teacher: Can anyone tell me what plants take in from the air?

turns.last_utterance: Teacher: Right! And what do they give back out?
turns.transcript:
Teacher: Can anyone tell me what plants take in from the air?
Student: Carbon dioxide.
Teacher: Right! And what do they give back out?

scenarios.setting: AAC user at a coffee shop counter, barista taking the order.
scenarios.scene: A coffee shop counter with a menu board behind the barista. Pastries in a glass case.

turns.last_utterance: Barista: Hi! What can I get started for you?
turns.transcript: Barista: Hi! What can I get started for you?

turns.last_utterance: Barista: Sure! What size?
turns.transcript:
Barista: Hi! What can I get started for you?
User: a coffee please
Barista: Sure! What size?

turns.last_utterance: Barista: Anything else?
turns.transcript:
Barista: Sure! What size?
User: medium
Barista: Anything else?

scenarios.setting: AAC user at a doctor's appointment, being asked about symptoms.
scenarios.scene: A doctor's exam room. A doctor in a white coat sits on a stool with a tablet.

turns.last_utterance: Doctor: So what's been bothering you today?
turns.transcript: Doctor: So what's been bothering you today?

turns.last_utterance: Doctor: How long has this been going on?
turns.transcript:
Doctor: So what's been bothering you today?
User: my stomach hurts
Doctor: How long has this been going on?

turns.last_utterance: Doctor: On a scale of one to ten, how bad is the pain?
turns.transcript:
Doctor: How long has this been going on?
User: a few days
Doctor: On a scale of one to ten, how bad is the pain?

scenarios.setting: A friend chatting casually about weekend plans.
scenarios.scene: A living room couch. A friend sits nearby with their phone.

turns.last_utterance: Friend: Want to do something this weekend?
turns.transcript: Friend: Want to do something this weekend?
plausible_utterances: what do you want to do

turns.last_utterance: Friend: We could see a movie, or go to the park?
turns.transcript:
Friend: Want to do something this weekend?
User: yes
Friend: We could see a movie, or go to the park?
